correctness.rationale: The non-dominant restriction makes singleton configurations fail and all size≥4 configurations succeed for p≤1/3. For p≤1/5 every pair succeeds; for p≤1/4 failed pairs intersect and at most five fail; for p≤1/3, successful pairs meet all 15 perfect matchings and at least five succeed, failed triples form a 2-intersecting family of size at most four. In the exceptional five-successful-pair case all successful pairs form a star and all triples succeed, yielding positive excess p²(1-p)³(5p−1). These exhaustive combinatorial cases yield exact T6/T5/T4 lower bounds, with positive ε core constructions and endpoint handling. Exact rational checker independently confirms incidence and polynomial identities; infinite claim follows from proof, not tests.

value.rationale: The new classification addresses an explicitly motivated Bernoulli mean-exceedance conjecture at six stakes, where general methods give no full interval. It identifies the sharp least risk when no single stake suffices and proves nontrivial changes of optimal 6-, 5-, and 4-core constructions at exact critical probabilities 1/5 and 1/4. Interlocking perfect-matching and pairwise-2-intersection obstructions explain the transition; the result is stronger than an isolated m=6 verification or a numerical table.
